children: , the diabetes and obesity-drug powerhouse, rose approximately 0.5% to $45.545 Tuesday after rolling out the Wegovy pill in Germany. That puts Novo's oral weight-loss treatment into the European Union's largest pharmaceutical marketand gives Germany the EU's first taste of the new pill.

Prices will change with dosage, but Novo expects the pill to cost roughly as much as Wegovy injections, currently priced between 170 and 280 in Germany. Novo believes pills could capture more than one-third of GLP-1 use by 2030. During its second-quarter reporting, the company said Wegovy already commanded approximately 90% of the oral obesity market.
That 90% share now faces a serious durability test. Eli Lilly

has launched its Foundayo pill in Britain and is targeting approval in more than 40 markets. Pills could unlock demand from patients who dislike injections, but similar pricing means conveniencenot savingsis doing the heavy lifting. The valuation gap is equally hard to ignore: Novo's $45.545 share price sits 57.88% below its GF Value estimate of $108.13. Novo has the early lead; reimbursement, repeat prescriptions and Lilly's expansion will decide whether it keeps it.

title: Novo Nordisk Trades Nearly 58% Below GF Value as Wegovy Pill Launches in Germany
